data.one_liner: Cross-platform BSON ObjectId implementation in Dart
data.what_it_does: Provides a BSON ObjectId implementation in Dart that allows you to create and parse ObjectIds. It works across platforms without requiring a reference to the mongodb or bson packages.
use_when: You need to generate or parse MongoDB-style ObjectIds in Dart
You want ObjectId support without depending on heavy database packages like mongodb or bson
avoid_when: You are already using the full mongodb or bson packages which include their own ObjectId implementation
strengths: Independent of mongodb and bson packages
weaknesses: Very narrow scope focused solely on BSON ObjectIds
